network_fee_policy.note: This is a Founder-set maximum budget, not a guarantee of network acceptance. Do not sign or broadcast if the wallet or transaction preview indicates a total network fee above 3 TON. Re-estimate immediately before signing; do not split or retry transactions in a way that bypasses the cap.
